scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U misgastos -d mis_gastos -f /seed/dev.sql
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/api
